intendedObjective: Prepare the visitor note for a neighborhood zine through light editing.
acceptableEditScope: Small editorial adjustments retaining clipped delivery, limited firsthand coverage, observations, and suggestion.
stableFactsAndClaims: The visitor used the new audio guide and initially took the long route accidentally near the tapestry room.
The guide has 16 stops; the visitor heard nine before lunch and makes no judgment about the other seven.
The wooden printing block explanation was especially good.
A transcript is available during playback; the largest clock's strike obscured a few recorded words.
Stop numbers are beside objects; the visitor suggests adding them to the room map after difficulty finding the pottery case.
protectedNamesNumbersDatesQuotesPhrases: stop numbers on the room map
requiredForm: First-person visitor note for a neighborhood zine.
voiceConstraints: Wry observations without inflating the scope of the review.
